_help: Settings for the group-meeting bot. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored.
DAY-TO-DAY CHANGES DO NOT HAPPEN HERE: people mark themselves out, add special sessions or cancel
meetings in the shared Google Sheet (Availability tab). The bot copies the sheet into the
so anything you type into those four sections by hand will be overwritten by the sheet.
Edit this file only for: the rotation order, the semester dates, meeting days/time, people
joining or leaving (`joined` / `left`), and Slack member IDs for @-mentions.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. After you commit a change, GitHub validates the file and regenerates SCHEDULE.md.
New semester: update start_date/end_date, run `python rotation.py sheet-template` and import the
result into the Availability tab (see README).
_slack_ids_help: Optional. Paste each person's Slack member ID (profile > three dots > Copy member ID) to @-mention them in reminders. Leave empty to show plain names.
_synced_from_sheet: The four sections below are filled in automatically from the Google Sheet.
